replace=config
replace=data

new-game=0

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local points={{util.vector3(-134,1776,-282),util.vector3(77,1775,-296),util.vector3(240,1788,-260)}}
local step=1;local elapsed=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<.1 then return end;elapsed=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on actual western path')
 print('PoisonApproach Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 local goblin=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x3b513))
 if goblin and goblin:isValid() then print('PoisonApproach goblin '..tostring(goblin.position)..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(goblin))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(goblin).current) end
 if step>#points then
  local goblin=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x3b513));assert(goblin and goblin:isValid(),'Original goblin missing')
  if Actor.isDead(goblin) then print('PoisonContact dead health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(goblin).current);return end
  local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(goblin:getBoundingBox().center)
  local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
  local function units(a) return math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(a*256+.5))) end
  print(string.format('PoisonContact aim x=%d y=%d',units(ax),units(ay)))
  local d=(goblin.position-self.position):length()
  print('PoisonContact alive health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(goblin).current..' distance='..d)
  if d<150 and math.abs(ax)<.04 and math.abs(ay)<.04 then print('PoisonContact ready') end
  return
 end
 local delta=points[step]-self.position
 if math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)<40 then print('PoisonApproach waypoint '..step..' reached');step=step+1;return end
 local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5));local yaw=math.atan2(view.y*delta.x-view.x*delta.y,view.x*delta.x+view.y*delta.y)
 print(string.format('PoisonApproach waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),0))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.025 then print('PoisonApproach waypoint '..step..' facing') end
end}}}}
